profile_text.body:
Bain & Company is a management consulting firm. On its own website it describes itself as a global firm that advises leaders on strategy, marketing, organization, operations, IT and M&A, across all industries and geographies. The site presents the firm as for-profit and lists bain.com as its website.

The site's material on artificial intelligence is limited to a stated position rather than a product: it says that to justify the investment, AI must do more than boost productivity and will need to unlock new sources of growth and value. No AI products, litigation, or other holdings are recorded for the company.
